posts.title: Turbulent Times Call For Experimental Law
posts.description: There are good reasons for laws not changing too quickly. In a rapidly changing world, however, this slowness can be a problem. Enter: regulatory sandboxes, or Experimentierklauseln as the Germans apparently call them. «Experimental clauses» are temporary or scope-limited changes to laws, «to allow for real-time adaptation or alteration in response to changing threats, climate…
